items.title: Register other ~/dev ROS repos in the project-administration hub
items.description: Some registered/candidate repos (e.g. typescript-wasm-kernel, ROS-WorkerDaemon) may have an older ROS install without the work backlog; upgrade before registering so hub-created work items land correctly.

items.title: Provider-neutral adaptive development telemetry
items.description: Inspect ROS and integrate trustworthy provider-neutral execution telemetry, capability discovery, deterministic repository metrics, validation, documentation, and tests.
